nodes.long_description:
Immerse yourself in an exhilarating virtual reality adventure that pays homage to the classic action films of the past. You step into the shoes of a fearless hero facing a harrowing challenge.

Terrorists have seized control of a sprawling skyscraper, holding innocent hostages captive within its towering walls. As the lone warrior who can save the day, it is your duty to navigate each treacherous floor, confronting relentless enemies with swift precision and tactical prowess.

With every enemy you kill and with every hostage you rescue, you earn XP that can be used to unlock various weapons and upgrades.
nodes.short_description: Prepare for an intense VR experience as you step into the shoes of a courageous hero in a high-rise nightmare. Your mission is clear: rescue hostages, neutralize ruthless terrorists, and ascend through the floors of a besieged skyscraper. With each floor conquered, unlock new gear and confront a relentless mastermind in a heart-stopping rooftop showdown. Will you save the day or succumb to the chaos?

nodes.change_log:
Hard Line Update 12 - All Physical

New
• You can now reset stats via the settings
• Redesigned the UI to look better
• Objects like screens, keyboards, books, pictures, etc. can now be shot or pushed around or even grabbed and thrown at guards. Screens will glitch and go black when shot
• Glass walls can now shatter after getting shot multiple times.
• Guards hear props falling and will investigate
• Bullet holes
• Handcuffing a bandit in heavier body armour now earns more XP, just like taking them down does.
• Bandits who end up too close to you now back off to a firing position instead of freezing in place.
• Comfort Vignette setting (Off / Low / High): the view narrows softly while you move with the stick or turn smoothly, to reduce motion sickness.
• Shooting furniture now looks and sounds like what it's made of: wood splinters off desks and shelves, metal sparks off racks and kitchen gear, fluff off sofas, and plastic hits on plastic tables.
• Once a floor is cleared, the objective reminds you how many hostages that are still cuffed, that you can rescue.
• Censor mosaics effect toggleable on npc faces and blood
• New random encounter: stuck elevator
• New floor: an open-space office on fire. Dodge the flames (they burn you and the bandits), fight through the smoke, and watch the blaze slow down in bullet time.

Fixed
• Fixed guards awareness. They should be more aware of you now.
• The guards FOV now also increases when you are closer to them
• Fixed the elevator music getting muted when you mute the game music. Added a seperate setting for muting the elevator music.
• Made some fixes to how height calibration works.
• Increased the volume of guards VOs, so they can be heard even when music plays
• Yelling "Freeze!" only makes bandits you can see surrender (glass doesn't block the view); bandits in other rooms hear you and come looking instead.
• Guards on a new floor no longer start out getting up, turning toward an old gunshot, or opening fire before they see you.
• Handcuffs no longer snap back onto a hostage after you free them.
• Handcuffing a bandit who is already dead no longer counts as killing a cuffed bandit or costs you XP.
• Bullets no longer hit the invisible barrier at the rooftop edge: you can shoot the helicopter from anywhere on the roof, and its shots can reach you.
• Guards no longer stop reacting to gunfire and "Freeze!" calls after checking out their first noise. They now come after every shot they hear, so fights are tougher.

Improved
• Dying now costs 15% of your banked XP, instead of 25%, and the game-over screen shows exactly how much you lost.
• Bandits now lower their gun smoothly into the holster instead of it teleporting there, when they die
• Made some optimizations to the bandits
• Restarting after death or finishing the game now fades smoothly to black and back into the lobby.
• The game now pauses automatically when you open the Meta menu or take off your headset, so you come back to a frozen fight instead of a game over.
• Bullet time is smoother: starting it no longer causes a small hitch, and every sound, including new hits and voices, is slowed from its very first moment.
• Improved the handcuff model and made improvements so the handcuffs fit the npcs wrists better

Hard Line 0.9.0

New
• Bullet Time. Slow down time like a real action movie. Earn bullet time as you take out hostiles
• Better impact particles: glass, blood and wall
• Better bullet trail effect. looks awesome in slowmotion
• Health packs now spawn around, you can pick up to get 25% health back
• New Upgrade: More Max health
• New Upgrade: More bullet time
• Added music. muteable in the settings
• Added setting for adjusting snap turn amount
• Depending on which hand hold the weapon, the magazine will now show on the opposite side
• Kicking can now knock over hostiles

Fixed
• Fixed issue with the game softlocking when the boss destroyed itself during XP count-up
• Tased Hostiles now recover if tasing stopped. They also dont snap back, but smoothly animate into position
• knocked-out hostile who is shot no longer flickers between “knocked out” and “last breath” every frame.
• grabbing or hitting a dead, unconscious, dying or tased NPC no longer forces the “being grabbed” combat state. Corpses don’t pop back up, and dragging a NPC doesn’t reset his knock-out timer.
• when the smoke ends, only NPCs it actually blinded are restored. Surrendering, dead or fighting NPCs keep their state.
• Tasing a hostage or the helicopter no longer throws an error or leaves the taser stuck.
• Armour levels already picked are now restored on load, so they aren’t offered again.
• A more secure savesystem
• Optimized Bullets
• Fixed a crash when a gun sound was missing
• the player only counts as inside when their feet are in the elevator, so leaning in or out no longer starts or stops it.
• after 2 minutes the game shows the “Enter the Elevator” prompt but stays in the lobby state. The lobby no longer counts as a cleared floor.
• Picking “none” on attachments now survives a restart.
• Fixed issues with repeating upgrades appearing on level-up screen
• Made some general optimizations to the hostiles, the game master and the npc behaviours
• Extended mag upgrade now clears the old magazine waiting in the holster
• the wake up sound of knocked out hostiles is no longer cut off
• a hostile grabbed a second time looks toward the grab again, and a crouching hostile stands up when grabbed.
• Hostile difficulty no longer reset if you exit the game and return again
• Lower hostile accuracy now actually gives less XP
• Shown tutorial text is now stored, so it doesnt show again the next time you play
• Fixed the issue with hostiles flying up in the air when killed while kneeling
• Fixed issue with shells sometimes not being loadable into the shotgun

Hotfix v0.8.1

* Doors now stops projectiles, except for glass doors
* Bad guys no longer thinks they can see the player through walls and doors
* Weapons no longer fire, if sticking through walls
* When dying, you now only lose 25% of your XP. Not all of it

Update 10 is now Live! 
Bringing you weapon attachments from suppressors, to scopes and red dot sights.

Unlock attachments by using the designated weapons.

Update 9 is finally here!



In this update I have focused on improving the graphics and added in various unique floors to the skyscraper.

Moreover, improvements to the AI has been made. The AI should now be more responsive and communicate with eachother.
